notes.title: Patch v1.9
notes.content:
- Added language localization: Spanish, Italian, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Russian
- Removed the stamina bar and the strenght bar (many users found such a gameplay very boring)
- Added a size indicator for pickable objects (now it's easier to compare objects) 
- Added a "Run" button
